plan.notes: Official term-by-term Curricular Plan for the standalone Computer Science BS, from the official 2022-2023 University at Buffalo Undergraduate Catalog (UB's official catalog archive at catalog-archives.apps.buffalo.edu). This is the most recent UB catalog that publishes a complete term-by-term sequence for this program: the current Acalog catalog's (2023-2024 and later) standalone BS program pages publish degree requirements but no term-by-term table. The source lists several slots as '3 or 4' credits ('Pathway or ENG 105' in both freshman semesters; the 'CSE 442 or CSE 494' senior capstone) while stating 'Total Credits Required for Degree: 120'. This file instantiates one coherent 120-credit path: ENG 105 (4 cr) in freshman fall, a 3-credit UB Curriculum Pathway course in freshman spring, and CSE 442 (4 cr) as the senior capstone; catalog alternatives are documented in the choice_note of each affected slot. Prerequisites are not listed in the curricular-plan source, so prereq arrays are left empty — consult the catalog course descriptions. UB Curriculum key from the source: 6 Pathway courses required (3 Global + 3 Thematic); Scientific Literacy & Inquiry SLI1/SLI2; UB Seminar (UBS); UB Capstone (CAP). Course titles are given as printed in the 2022-2023 curricular plan.
